packages.description: Package settings keyed by the PKGBUILD's path relative to the workspace folder, like "packaging/aur/podium/PKGBUILD".

versionSource.description: Where the version comes from. Remembered from the last "Set Version" or "Generate pkgver()".

path.description: Version file to read. Relative to the workspace folder when setting pkgver=, or to srcDir inside a generated pkgver().

command.description: Shell command that prints the version, for the "command" type.

appendRevision.description: pkgver() only: append the git revision count and commit, like 1.2.0.r42.abc1234.

srcDir.description: pkgver() only: folder inside $srcdir the function runs in.

extraFiles.description: Extra files next to the PKGBUILD to publish, like .gitignore or LICENSE. Local sources, install scripts and changelogs are always published.

commitMessage.description: AUR commit message for this package. {version} and {pkgbase} are replaced.
